title: The hand-off
scenario:
Your studio builds a vertical teaser for a bottle brand. The plan below chains four steps. Each step passes a file to the next one. The plan is made up for this case. The limits are copied from the vendors' docs.

Find which hand-offs will break.
exhibit:
Hand-off plan (made up for this case)
  Step 1  Hero photo: square (1:1), 4 MB PNG.
          Sent as a data URI to a Runway video job. The job is 9:16.
  Step 2  Voice-over made with OpenAI speech, format: pcm.
          It goes into the video editor.
  Step 3  Veo 3.1 clip made on Friday at 18:00.
          The team plans to download it on Monday at 09:00.
  Step 4  The Runway task output link is pasted into the client email.

Limits from the vendors' docs
  Runway: image data URI limit 5 MB (the encoded size);
          base64 makes a file about 33% bigger;
          image by URL limit 16 MB; URLs must be HTTPS; redirects are not followed;
          inputs are auto-cropped to the target aspect ratio;
          output links expire within 24-48 hours.
  OpenAI speech: default mp3. pcm = raw samples, no header.
          wav = uncompressed WAV audio. flac = lossless compression.
  Veo: generated videos are stored on the server for 2 days.

questions.prompt: Step 1 sends a 4 MB PNG as a data URI. What is the best fix?

options.text: Send it by HTTPS URL or as an upload. Encoded as base64, 4 MB becomes about 5.3 MB, over the 5 MB data URI limit.
options.explanation: Right. The limit applies to the encoded data URI. The URL route allows 16 MB for an image.

options.text: Send it by a short link that redirects to the file.
options.explanation: Runway says redirects are not followed. A 3XX response counts as a failed request.

options.text: No fix. 4 MB is under 5 MB, so it is fine.
options.explanation: The 5 MB limit is for the encoded size. Base64 adds about 33%, so 4 MB grows to about 5.3 MB.

options.text: Send it anyway. The tool will shrink it for you.
options.explanation: Runway's page gives a hard limit for data URIs and says to upload larger files. It does not promise to resize them.

questions.prompt: Step 1 also gives a square photo to a 9:16 video job. What will happen?

options.text: The tool stretches the photo to fill the frame.
options.explanation: Runway's primer says the input is cropped, not stretched.

options.text: The photo is auto-cropped to 9:16. This can silently change the composition, for example cutting off a label.
options.explanation: Right. This is what Runway's primer says. Prepare a 9:16 version first.

options.text: The tool adds blank bars on the sides to keep the whole photo.
options.explanation: Runway says it auto-crops. It does not mention bars.

options.text: The job always fails with an error.
options.explanation: Runway says it crops silently. It does not say a mismatch is an error.

questions.prompt: The video editor needs a standard, uncompressed audio file with a header. Which OpenAI speech format should step 2 use?

options.text: mp3
options.explanation: mp3 is the default for general use. WAV is the uncompressed choice.

options.text: flac
options.explanation: flac is lossless compression, so it is a compressed file.

options.text: pcm
options.explanation: pcm is raw samples without the header, so an editor may not open it as it is.

options.text: wav
options.explanation: Right. WAV is described as uncompressed WAV audio. It has the header an editor expects.

questions.prompt: Step 3: will the Veo clip still be on Google's server on Monday at 09:00?

options.text: No. Veo stores a video for 2 days, so it was removed on Sunday at 18:00. Download it before Sunday 18:00.
options.explanation: Right. Google says to download within 2 days of generation.

options.text: Yes. Videos stay until you delete them.
options.explanation: Google says generated videos are stored on the server for 2 days, then removed.

options.text: Yes, but only if the video is in 1080p.
options.explanation: Nothing in the docs links the 2-day storage time to resolution.

options.text: It depends on the Runway tier.
options.explanation: The clip is on Veo. Runway rules do not apply to it.

questions.prompt: Step 4: what is wrong with pasting the Runway output link into the client email?

options.text: The link is temporary and expires within 24-48 hours. Download the file and send it from your own storage.
options.explanation: Right. Runway says to save the data and not to expose these links directly in your product.

options.text: Nothing. Output links stay valid for as long as the project exists.
options.explanation: Runway says the links expire within 24-48 hours.

options.text: The link only works for the person who made the task.
options.explanation: Runway's page says the links expire. It does not say they are limited to one person.

options.text: The video should be sent as a data URI instead.
options.explanation: A data URI is a way to send files in a request, with size limits. Output files are saved by downloading them.
